papers.title: Limitations of transmucosal ketamine administration for chronic pain in dogs with osteoarthritis.
papers.authors: Seabolt RA, Elam LH, Griffenhagen GM, Duerr FM
papers.abstract: This prospective, open-label clinical trial aimed to evaluate the efficacy of low-dose keta-mine (0.5 mg/kg) administered by oral transmucosal route every 8 h in client-owned dogs with refractory, chronic osteoarthritis pain. Objective gait analysis was the primary outcome measure for orthopedic function relating to pain.
